{{Quote|We cannot allow the Chancellor to move this Enhanced Privacy Invasion Bill forward.''"<br />"''We're all in agreement, then.|Bail Organa and Philo, shortly before being interrupted by the intrusion of Cad Bane|<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />}}
'''Philo''' was a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Politics/Legends|politician]] who gained much respect as a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], he led a coalition of like-minded senators in opposition to the [[Enhanced Privacy Invasion Bill/Legends|Enhanced Privacy Invasion Bill]] that was supported by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Philo determinedly worked with his colleagues&mdash;who included prominent senators [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]], [[Riyo Chuchi/Legends|Riyo Chuchi]], and [[Kin Robb/Legends|Kin Robb]]&mdash;to prevent the legislation from being passed.

At a meeting shortly before the vote on the bill was to take place, Philo and his associates were [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|confronted]] by a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] led by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], who took the senators hostage to force Palpatine into releasing the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] from [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic custody]]. Although Philo, regarding Bane's audacity with contempt, attempted to walk out from the hostage situation, he was [[Laser/Legends|shot]] in the back and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter.

==Biography==
===Career in the Senate===
{{Quote|Senator Philo has called a meeting in the lobby before we vote on the Enhanced Privacy Invasion Bill.|Bail Organa to Padmé Amidala|<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />}}
[[File:Galactic Senate.png|thumb|left|250px|Philo represented his people as a member of the Republic Senate.]]
The [[Gran/Legends|Gran]]<ref name="Hostage Crisis" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="A Galaxy Divided 1" /> Philo lived during the [[Great Peace of the Republic|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], during which [[Time/Legends|time]]<ref name="Hostage Crisis" /> he<ref name="Hostage Crisis Ep Guide" /> became a [[Politics/Legends|politician]]. By the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], in which the Republic fought the separatist [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] for [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] supremacy, Philo,<ref name="Hostage Crisis" /> a strong supporter of the Republic,<ref name="A Galaxy Divided 1" /> became a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] within the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Republic Senate]]. He worked out of the [[Senate Building/Legends|headquarters]] of the Senate on the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Hostage Crisis" /> During his career in the Senate, his employees included fellow Gran [[Salo]], who devoted his life to serving Philo.<ref name="A Galaxy Divided 1" />

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Hostage Crisis Date" /> [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] advocated for the passage of the [[Enhanced Privacy Invasion Bill/Legends|Enhanced Privacy Invasion Bill]] in the Senate. Philo was one of the senators who did not approve of the legislation, and he formed a coalition of like-minded opponents to the proposal, including<ref name="Hostage Crisis" /> prominent senators<ref name="Encyclopedia: Bane">{{SWE|characters|cadbane|Cad Bane}}</ref> [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]], [[Kin Robb/Legends|Kin Robb]] and [[Riyo Chuchi/Legends|Riyo Chuchi]]. Other members of Philo's coalition included<ref name="Hostage Crisis" /> Senators [[Jakker-Sun/Legends|Jakker-Sun]], [[Dantum Roohd/Legends|Dantum Roohd]], [[Zinn Paulness/Legends|Zinn Paulness]], and a [[Unidentified Christophsian senator/Legends|Christophsian senator]].<ref name="Hostage Crisis Ep Guide" />

===Killed by a bounty hunter===
{{Quote|It was an honor to work for such a great man who held the Republic in such high esteem. Cad Bane will ''pay'' for this despicable act! I will make sure of it.|Salo laments Philo's murder|<ref name="A Galaxy Divided 1" />}}
[[File:Executive Annex Dome East Wing.png|thumb|right|250px|Philo and several like-minded senators gathered in the Republic Executive Building's East Wing.]]
As Philo and his political bloc took a stand against the Enhanced Privacy Invasion Bill, the legislation was put to a vote. The morning of the Senate's scheduled vote on the proposal, Philo called his colleagues to an important meeting in the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building's]]<ref name="Hostage Crisis" /> [[Senate East Wing/Legends|East Wing]] lobby atrium<ref name="Hostage Crisis Ep Guide" /> to ensure their continued opposition to the bill. Organa, Amidala, and the eight other senators of their group were in attendance, and Philo confirmed that they would all vote against Palpatine in the decision on the legislation. Their caucus was interrupted when the lobby was invaded and [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|taken over]] by a group of [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] led by the notorious [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]]. Aided by several [[IG-86 sentinel droid/Legends|IG-86 sentinel droids]] and fellow [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] and [[Shahan Alama/Legends|Shahan Alama]], Bane took Philo and his colleagues hostage, to be used as leverage to force Palpatine into freeing the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]], who was currently in [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|prison]] for previous crimes against the Republic. Surrounding the senators with his comrades, Bane warned the politicians to stand down if they wished to live.<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />

[[File:PhiloDeath-HostageCrisis.png|thumb|left|250px|Philo is killed by Cad Bane while trying to leave the Executive Building's East Wing.]]
Outraged by Bane's impudence, Philo attempted to press pass him and out of the lobby, refusing to listen to the bounty hunter's demands. When Philo walked past Bane, the unmoved bounty hunter drew one of his [[LL-30 blaster pistol/Legends|LL-30 blaster pistols]] and [[Laser/Legends|shot]] the Gran senator in the back, instantly [[Death/Legends|killing]] him and showing the other senators that he meant business. Bane's hostage takeover of the Senate proved effective, and his team was able to secure Ziro the Hutt's release from [[Prison/Legends|prison]].<ref name="Hostage Crisis" /> The incident was later reported in a broadcast of the Republic's [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] as part of the [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] [[Rule Davenbay]]'s ''[[A Galaxy Divided]]'' segment. For the broadcast, Davenbay interviewed Salo, who expressed his sadness with Philo's death and swore to avenge Bane's murder of his role model.<ref name="A Galaxy Divided 1" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|As long as everybody behaves, this will be quick and painless. Do nothing, and it will all be over soon.''"<br />"''I don't know ''who'' you think you are, but I, for one, have no intention of listening to this kind of insolence.|Cad Bane and Philo, just before the latter is shot by the former|audio=BanePhilo.flac|<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />}}
[[File:PhilovsBane-HC.png|thumb|right|250px|Philo stands up to Cad Bane, an ultimately fatal move that would result in his death.]]
A Gran with three brown-[[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]],<ref name="Hostage Crisis" /> Philo possessed the rare Gran trait of<ref name="Hostage Crisis Decoded">{{TCW|Hostage Crisis|d=y}}</ref> blue skin,<ref name="Hostage Crisis Ep Guide" /> which was sparse among his commonly tan-skinned [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Hostage Crisis Decoded" /> A prominent<ref name="Encyclopedia: Bane" /> Republic senator, Philo held the Republic in high esteem during the Clone Wars,<ref name="A Galaxy Divided 1" /> a time when the Republic Senate was accused of widespread corruption and its effectiveness largely questioned.<ref name="Jedi: Mace Windu">''[[Jedi: Mace Windu]]''</ref><ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

Philo was respected by many peers and colleagues, including his employee, Salo, who considered it an honor to devote himself to a life of service to the Gran senator. Salo subsequently directed much ire toward Cad Bane following his murder of Philo during the Senate hostage crisis.<ref name="A Galaxy Divided 1" /> Philo was not intimidated by bounty hunters like Bane, though he underestimated the notorious mercenary's dangerousness. Refusing to tolerate "insolence" of any kind, Philo went so far as to press pass Bane out of the East Wing atrium in a show of contempt for the mercenary. That action cost him his life, for the unperturbed Bane killed him in a show of force to demonstrate the seriousness of his demands to the other senator captives.<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />

==Skills and abilities==
Philo [[Language/Legends|spoke]] [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic]].<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />

==Equipment==
The Gran wore an ornate white [[Clothing/Legends|tunic]], with gold trim. He also wore gold and white pants.<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Hostage_Crisis.png|thumb|right|230px|Philo was one of the ten senators taken hostage by Cad Bane in "Hostage Crisis."]]
The character of Senator Philo was created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series and first appeared in the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] finale, "[[Hostage Crisis]]," which aired on [[March 20]], [[2009]]. In the episode, he was voiced by voice actor [[Phil LaMarr]], who also portrayed Bail Organa<ref name="Hostage Crisis Ep Guide" /> and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] for the series.<ref name="Lair of Grievous Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode010.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lair of Grievous}}</ref> In the episode, Philo's early and violent death at the hands of Cad Bane exemplified the "instant effectiveness" of Bane and his bounty hunter troupe, which was intentionally established by Series Director [[Dave Filoni]] and the series' production team for the introduction of bounty hunters in "Hostage Crisis."<ref name="Hostage Crisis Commentary">{{SW|url=video/hostage-crisis-episode-featurette|text="Hostage Crisis" Episode Featurette}}</ref> Philo's name was misspelled once as "Phylo" in the annotated ''Decoded'' re-airing of "Hostage Crisis" on [[Cartoon Network]], despite being spelled correctly earlier in the re-airing.<ref name="Hostage Crisis Decoded" />

In [[2011]], Philo was featured in the non-[[canon]]ical video game ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'', which adapted the Senate hostage crisis and portrayed Philo as one of Bane's hostages, albeit without being killed by the bounty hunter<ref name="LEGO Star Wars III">''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]''</ref> as he was in the episode.<ref name="Hostage Crisis" /> Following the "Hostage Crisis" level, Philo could be purchased as a playable character for the game's "Free Play" mode.<ref name="LEGO Star Wars III" /> In the game's [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] version, he was instead made available after "[[The Gungan General]]" level.<ref name="LEGO Star Wars III Prima Guide">[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars: Prima Official Game Guide|''LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>
